descriptions: This dataset contains 7 audio recordings (8 items) on the subject of the Egyptian economy in the 1990s.
Interviews were conducted in English, Arabic and Dutch. Interview summaries and metadata are prepared in English.

data_sources: Interviews were conducted by Cornelis Hulsman, Drs., and his colleagues at the Cairo Foreign Press Association. Summaries and metadata of the audio recordings were provided by interns at CIDT-CAWU.
